title: Fragment highlight range assumes the English template layout
trigger: A translated qll_money_fragment_on_for (or any template whose Fragment word is not right after {prefix}, or a translated link word of different length) makes prefix.len()..prefix.len()+link.len() exceed the sentence or split a char
effect: StyledText::with_highlights gets an out-of-range or non-boundary range and can panic while painting the box
fix: Find the Fragment word's range in the formatted sentence with str::find, drop the highlight when absent, and translate the prefix.

title: A program row click's resolve answer opens the join or link box even after the list that asked was closed
trigger: Setup page > 'View existing programs', click a program row (open_affiliate_program), then close the programs box or the earn layer before getChatAffiliateProgram answers.
effect: The join box (or the link box) opens over whatever is on screen now, for a list the user already left.
fix: Carry the asking surface in EarnPurpose::ConnectedProgram and drop the answer unless that list (programs box or the Join page for that peer) is still open.

title: A bot photo asked for by a program list is never asked again when its download fails
trigger: Open an affiliate programs page while the photo download of a listed bot fails (network drop).
effect: photos_asked keeps the bot, so its row shows initials until the account switches (OnScreen is rebuilt).
fix: Leave the retry to the file layer (ask while user_photo_path is None and no download is active) instead of an asked-once set.

title: photos_asked records a bot before download_user_photo is sent, so a refused request is never repeated
trigger: Open the affiliate programs page when download_user_photo returns Err (driver closing); the bot id is already in photos_asked.
effect: That program row keeps initials instead of the bot photo until the account is switched away and back.
fix: Insert only when the send returns Ok, or track Fetch<()> per bot.

title: drain_earn shows only the last of several notes and drops the rest
trigger: Open a channel Monetization page when both the TON statistics and the Stars statistics fail in the same poll tick; both push their reason to earn.notes.
effect: One error toast is shown; the other is lost.
fix: Show the notes one after another through the toast queue, or join them.

title: Setup sliders are two Options built once from the setup page and never re-keyed to the bot or rebuilt when the page's params are replaced
trigger: Open a bot's affiliate setup, then have earn.setup replaced without open_earn (a reload of the same panel through load_earn_panel after setup was cleared, or the demo path where open_earn keeps the old setup).
effect: The slider knobs keep the old stops/positions while the labels (format_commission of setup.params) show the new values.
fix: One Option<SetupSliders { bot_user_id, commission, duration }> rebuilt when bot_user_id or the program differs from earn.setup.

title: Join Program / Revoke answers are not matched to the box that sent them (JoinBox::joining, RevokeBox::sending are bools, answers carry no request id)
trigger: Click 'Join Program' for bot A, press Esc to close the box, open bot B's join box before A's connectAffiliateProgram answers. A's success (state/domains/payments/earn.rs:178-190) closes B's box and opens A's link box; A's error (:511-515) clears B's joining flag and toasts 'Failed'.
effect: The box the user is looking at closes or changes to another program's link box; a closed box's error toasts over an unrelated one.
fix: Give JoinBox and RevokeBox a stage enum Idle | Sending(RequestId) and apply Connect/Disconnect answers only when the open box waits_for that request, as Withdraw and SetupPage already do.

title: The withdraw amount field is refilled only when (peer, value) changes, so a reopened page keeps the old typed text
trigger: On a Stars Balance page type 1500 into the amount field, close the layer, reopen the same page; the balance is unchanged so prefilled == (peer, value) and the field is not refilled.
effect: The field shows the previous typed amount instead of the withdrawable maximum.
fix: Reset prefilled in open_earn (or key it by page open), or hold the amount as page state.

title: Bid button re-enables while a bid is still in flight once another auction's bid answers
trigger: Place a bid on auction A; before it answers, open auction B's bid box from the bar/Active Auctions and bid there (bidding becomes Some(B) only if A's had cleared). Or: A's answer clears `bidding` unconditionally while B's request is pending.
effect: apply_gift_market_ok/error set `market.bidding = None` without checking the gift id or request, so the button of the box whose bid is still in flight stops spinning and accepts a second press (a second Stars bid).
fix: `bidding: Option<(gift_id, RequestId)>`, cleared only by the answer whose request id matches.

title: Delete Gift confirmation is a kit alert not tied to the account or the gift list it was asked for
trigger: Gifts dialog > Delete Gift (alert opens) > switch account from the Dock/tray with the alert up, then press Delete.
effect: The on_ok closure calls confirm_delete_gift(id) on whatever live client is current and driver.delete_received_gift does not check the id is in the open list, so a stale id is sent for the other account (the server rejects it, the user sees an error for an action they never asked).
fix: Carry an OwnedBy<account,gift> in the closure and ignore the OK when the owner is not current.

title: market_replace skips after_market_pop so bid slider/custom field and hide_name outlive the replaced box
trigger: Auction bid box > 'Send a gift' (market_replace to AuctionSend) > back out and open another auction's bid box.
effect: The popped AuctionBid never reaches the arm that clears slider/custom, and hide_name is only cleared when the stack empties, so the old chosen amount / custom field / Hide My Name can show in the next box.
fix: Carry slider/custom/hide_name inside the MarketBox variants that own them so popping or replacing drops them.

title: requested_files is stored even when the downloads were not sent
trigger: Open a resale or auction box while the client is not connected or download_file returns Err.
effect: download_file/follow_gift_auction results are dropped with let _ and requested_files is updated whenever the set changes, so the failed set is never retried until the set changes; follow_gift_auction sets followed before a failed send.
fix: Record a file as requested only when its download request was sent; make following an enum with the request outcome.

title: drain_gift_market_notes shows only the last of several notes
trigger: Two market answers fail in one frame (for example a failed purchase and a failed craft).
effect: notes are taken as a Vec and only notes.into_iter().last() is shown; earlier ones are lost.
fix: Queue notes through the toast queue one by one.

title: Message typed in the send-gift list is carried into the resale buy 'Send' step
trigger: Send-gift box list view: type in the Premium gift message textarea > tap a sold-out gift's resale tile > pick a listing > Buy.
effect: pick_resale_listing resets gift_hide_name but not payments.gift_message_input, and the buy step shows and sends the same input, so the unrelated text is prefilled for the recipient.
fix: Reset the three send inputs in one place (a SendGiftInputs value created per box/step) instead of per call site.

title: SendGift box never names its window with open_box
trigger: Open the send-gift box from a chat window's header menu while the last press was in another window.
effect: SendGift is a session-wide dialog whose flag is set by the driver (send.open) and no site calls open_box(DialogKind::SendGift), so the box shows in the window of the last press, not the window that asked.
fix: Call open_box(DialogKind::SendGift) in open_send_gift_in / open_send_gift_to_user next to the driver call.

title: gift_premium_by_stars is not reset when the send-gift box opens
trigger: Send-gift box for a friend > tick 'Pay with Stars instead' > close > open the box for another person.
effect: reset_send_gift_inputs clears the message, hide_name and pay_upgrade but not gift_premium_by_stars, so the Stars payment choice persists across recipients and opens.
fix: Put message, hide_name, pay_upgrade and by_stars in one SendGiftInputs struct replaced whole when the box opens.

title: Giveaway options of the previous chat are shown for a new chat while loading
trigger: Open the giveaway form for channel A (options load) > close > open it for channel B.
effect: request_giveaway_options sets *_loading but keeps options.premium/stars from A, and the body only shows 'Loading prices' when both lists are empty, so A's prices are shown and selectable until B's answer.
fix: Key the options by boosted chat (Fetch<Options> inside the form) and clear on open.

title: Direct Messages box shows an old failure and one save slot serves all targets
trigger: A Direct messages save fails for channel C; reopen the box for C. Or Remove Fee for a user is saving while the box is open.
effect: Opening the box does not reset PaidSave, so the earlier failure line shows at once; saving is is_saving() of any target, so an unrelated save disables Save. A success answer for one target also sets Idle for another.
fix: Make the save a per-target map of Idle/Saving/Failed, cleared when the box opens.

title: A clip that fails to open is retried on every render
trigger: Open a Premium feature preview whose downloaded clip cannot be opened by VideoPlayer::open.
effect: Only a player that opens and later reports Failed is kept in the slot; an Err from open is not remembered, so each re-render (hover, scroll, tick) re-opens the file.
fix: Make the slot an enum Idle / Playing(VideoPlayer) / Failed(file_id).

title: The revoke follow-up poll stops after 10 s without rechecking the Type box link
trigger: Revoke a public link while TDLib answers slower than 50 x 200 ms (flood wait).
effect: The spawn_screen loop exits without calling recheck_group_type_link, so the Type box keeps the 'link taken' status after the revoke finished.
fix: Run recheck_group_type_link from the reducer when the revoke settles, not from a bounded timer poll.

title: 'Buy more Stars' stays expanded after the Stars box is closed and reopened
trigger: Stars > Buy more Stars (expands list) > close Stars > open Stars again.
effect: The pack list is open at once because StarPacksState::open lives in the session and close_stars (mod.rs:129) does not reset it.
fix: Own the expanded flag in the Stars box UI state or reset it in close_stars.

title: Show My Last Seen toasts success when the privacy request is only queued
trigger: Press Show My Last Seen while TDLib then rejects setUserPrivacySettingRules.
effect: show_mine counts is_ok() of the send as success, shows 'last seen shown' and closes the box.
fix: Toast on the answer, or keep the box in a Saving stage.

title: Account switch closes the chooser and drops the waiting files
trigger: Files sent via 'Send to' while the chooser is open; user switches account (StartFiles uses .close).
effect: Files vanish silently; the chooser is gone.
fix: Keep the files app-wide until chosen or cancelled (they are app state), re-listing chats for the new account.

title: QUIT_ASKED is never cleared if a platform quit request is declined
trigger: A macOS terminate or session-end callback goes through noting_quit and then does not quit.
effect: Later main-window renderer loss: main_lost is false, so the main window is not reopened and the app keeps running with only chat windows or none.
fix: Set it only when the quit proceeds, or reset it when the quit is cancelled.

title: Publish on an already-busy suggestion closes the box silently
trigger: Press Publish twice (second box opened from a repeat click) or Publish a post whose approve is already in flight.
effect: confirm_suggest_accept sees busy, clears the accept box and returns with no toast or note, as if the second Publish succeeded; also no check that the suggestion is still pending (declined/expired by the other side) before sending approve.
fix: Keep the box open with a 'publishing' state, and check SuggestedPostState::Pending at confirm.

title: Decline reason input handler skips in_window_of
trigger: Open Decline from a chat window and press Enter in the reason field.
effect: open_suggest_decline subscribes with a plain subscribe_in; the price box's subscription wraps the same work in in_window_of(window). Without it, confirm_suggest_decline / close_kit_dialog_if_done run under the main window's slot state instead of the window the field lives in, so the dialog may not close or the wrong window's note is set.
fix: Wrap the handler in in_window_of like open_suggest_price.

title: Only the last suggested-post note and balance prompt of a drain survives
trigger: Two suggested-post requests fail between two frames (decline and add offer), or two BALANCE_TOO_LOW errors.
effect: drain_suggested_post_notes keeps notes.into_iter().last() and one take_suggested_post_balance_low(); earlier errors are lost, so a failed Decline/Approve can go unreported.
fix: Queue every note into the toast queue (it already keeps a failure list) and take a Vec of balance purposes.
